description:
I'm pretty sure the cherry isn't protected but I have added it anyway. Please confirm either way.


T30	Oak	Cut back from outbuilding by 1.5m due to branches rubbing on building. TPO No, T29

T40	Cherry	Fell to 1/1.5m from ground level and remove all arisings. Due to tree report stating the following - Wound resulting from historic failure at 1.5m vertical crack extending down to 1m. exposed structural root to the west with hstorical damage. Fungal fruiting body attached to the stem to the east, visually identified to most resemble Ganoderma sp. This tree doesn't seem to be included in your on line TPO map but is next to T64

1	T55	Goat willow	(Standing dead small tree on edge of G52) Fell as close to ground level as possible. This tree is one the edge of G52 so maybe part of this group
